name: Karen Lynfield
source: Karen "Break" Lynfield. Strong, pushy, and outwardly confident. She is the head of the Sisters Club and saves Vinny from a group of bullies on his first day of school at Cheyenne Point Academy. (Student Number: 1069-3010)
